releases.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure Friendship Bundle Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
releases.summary:
Making new friends is a big adventure. Embark on a cozy adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends and restore an abandoned island to its former glory. Can you solve the mystery hidden within? With the new Friendship Bundle, enjoy the complete adventure with both DLC content packs, City Town and Wheatflour Wonderland. Packed with extra characters, quests, locations, and collectible fun, the bundle delivers over 60 hours of additional gameplay, giving you new areas to explore and dozens of new quests to complete.
With the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition enjoy enhanced features: 

    Embark on your cosy adventure to Friendship Island with higher framerates and smoother visuals 
    Celebrating, customising and crafting never looked so good! Enjoy enhanced resolution on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system 
    Playing with your friends is more fun with CameraPlay! 
    Prefer playing with a mouse? Joy-Con™ mouse support is here.

releases.name: Robot City: Delivery
releases.summary: Take control of the world's most popular delivery robot! Race through the neon city, collect packages, use boosts and hearts, avoid bombs and obstacles, and unlock new levels. Can you deliver all the packages and become the best courier?

releases.name: WhoIsHe
releases.summary: A surreal point-and-click escape room mystery. Henry Grudge returns after seven years of being kidnapped, covered in blood and with no memories. Solve cryptic puzzles, search for hidden items, and uncover the dark truth. Who is he?

releases.name: Service Equals Survival
releases.summary: Service Equals Survival is an incremental real-time strategy and tower defence game, where you are a commander tasked with eliminating as many bugs as possible. Featuring limb-damage on bugs, turrets, airstrikes, and barbed wire.

releases.name: War Footing
releases.summary: War Footing puts you in command of a nation's defenses. With limited time & resources, and tension rising, can you build the military needed to save your country's independence?

releases.name: Melon Rally
releases.summary:
Help Casey get his toys back by building crazy contraptions. Create Rube Goldberg-like machines with toys and everyday items to solve puzzles and playtime scenarios. See the solutions your friends came up with, and share your own instantly with Game Center.

The fun doesn't stop there! Create your own contraptions with the toys you get back, and challenge your friends through email to solve them. You can use slingshots, RC trucks, darts, ropes, magnets, balloons, trapdoors, punching gloves, and more. Let's see who can come up with the craziest inventions!

Highlights:
• Smooth, physics based gameplay.
• More than 30 different items to create contraptions.
• Over 70 levels.
• Level editor to make your own contraptions.
• Tight Game Center integration.

releases.name: Hunt Me
releases.summary: HUNT ME is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Gather the ingredients for the ritual, weaken the threat and banish it. Be careful, you're also the prey!

releases.name: THE GUARDIANS
releases.summary:
For once, the world is at peace. The Guardians maintain the peace. They are the big brothers of the sky.

The Guardians is a decision based RPG with flight simulator and first person shooter mechanics. Every decision you make has consequences, your actions will shape the outcome.

Do you become a farmer, a medical professional, join the military, or even become unemployed. Whatever you choose will determine how you will experience the world.

releases.name: Tavern Talk: Complete Edition
releases.summary:
Discover the cozy fantasy world of Tavern Talk Complete Edition, the first-ever physical Nintendo Switch release of the beloved visual novel adventure.

This Deluxe Edition includes the full base game along with both the Pirate Palooza and Tempest Tantrum DLC on cartridge, delivering the complete Wayfarer’s Inn experience in one definitive package.

releases.name: The Nightmare Box Vol III
releases.summary:
Following the collections of The Nightmare Box Vol. 1 and 2, released in 2025, The Nightmare Box Vol. 3 includes NO-SKIN, Menace from the Deep and Stasis. Digitally published by Feardemic, the titles in The Nightmare Box Vol. 3 will drag you into the depths of fear. 

Meridiem has been responsible for the design and manufacture of this game pack, which aside from the three titles includes a set of three tarot cards to add to the collection of cards from the previous volume.

releases.name: Project RedTeam: Contract Offensive
releases.summary: Slash fruits in the coolest way.Ever wanted to be a be the greatest fruit slasher in the world ?This is your chance. Jump onboard and compete with players worldwise to be the best fruit slasher. Slash multiple fruits with a single stroke and earn more points, extra time or awards.FruitSlasher contains:- 3 game modes- Superior graphics- Addictive game concept- GameCenter support with a different leaderboard for each mode.- Combo cuts to earn more points, time or awards.- Upgrade to ad free Full Game
